startSlow.title: Start Slow
startSlow.desc: You don't need a massive sales department on day one. Fix your immediate bottleneck today, preserve your cash flow, and add new modules only when your pipeline is ready.

scout.title: Lead Qualification
scout.situation: Your CRM is cluttered with unqualified leads and spam. You waste hours chasing bad prospects instead of talking to ready buyers.
scout.whenToBuy: You need an expert to sift through signups, filter out the noise, and hand over only verified, highly-qualified leads ready for a real conversation.
scout.whenNotToBuy: Do not buy if you lack inbound volume. A scout cannot qualify leads if there is no traffic entering your funnel in the first place.

sdr.title: Outbound Prospecting
sdr.situation: Your product is solid and inbound is steady, but you need proactive outreach to tap into cold audiences and fill the calendar predictably.
sdr.whenToBuy: You are ready to target specific accounts. An SDR will run targeted cold campaigns, handle objections, and book high-intent meetings on your calendar.
sdr.whenNotToBuy: Do not buy if you have not validated your market. Cold outreach with an unproven offer will only burn through your potential customer base.

closer.title: Deal Closing
closer.situation: Your calendar is packed with qualified meetings, leaving you no time to run the business. You are stuck as a full-time sales rep.
closer.whenToBuy: You have a repeatable sales script and proven conversion rate. A closer will take over your demos, allowing you to step back from selling.
closer.whenNotToBuy: Do not buy if you have not closed deals yourself. A closer scales what works, they cannot invent a working sales motion from scratch.
